text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
What a race! Ines Fujin secures a<n>fantastic victory
at the Japanese<n>Derby!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Just listen as the crowd goes wild! A<n>thunderous
round of applause for this<n>year's Derby champion!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! I did it! I really did it!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm... the Derby champion! Aha...<n>hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Girl with False Eyelashes
text_block_list.text: Insane! That was totally wild, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
That was crazy! She looks totally<n>wiped out! But
still...

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text: Why does she look so freakin' cool?!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Little Sisters
text_block_list.text: Big Sis! That was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I don't know what to do with<n>myself! These
cheers... are all for me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay to have such an<n>incredible moment
all to myself?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, I have to go. Everyone is<n>applauding me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I have to hurry to the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Agh... Ahaha. It's no good. I can<n>barely stay
standing...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I have to move... I have to<n>respond to
everyone's cheers...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha... I, uh, don't think I can move<n>right now. Can
you go on ahead and<n>give my thanks to everyone?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...C'mon, don't ask for theimpossible. Someone's gotta answerthose cheers, so you should hurry on over and...
choice_data_list: But you're the one everyone is waiting for.
But you're the one everyone is waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: INES! INES! INEEES! INEEES!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: INEEES! INEEES! INEEES! INEEES!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haha... I'm not even in the winner's<n>circle yet.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Are they going to keep chanting my<n>name until I
arrive?
choice_data_list: That's how inspiring your performance was.
That's how inspiring your performance was.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Geez...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Can we go slowly? I think I should be<n>able to make
it...
choice_data_list: Sure. Here, grab onto my shoulder.
Sure. Here, grab onto my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks! Don't complain if I'm<n>too heavy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I wasn't kidding when I told Trainer I<n>couldn't
walk. I mean, I used up<n>every last ounce of energy I
had in<n>the race just now.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(This was my dream—charging across<n>the Derby
finish line with the crowd's<n>passionate cheers
behind me.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (And now, I've finally done it.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(But now... When I can hear everyone<n>cheering my
name so loud and<n>clear...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: INEEES! INEEES! INEEES! INEEES!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If everyone's cheering this loud for<n>me, then I gotta
give them what they<n>want—one final spurt!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But the Triple Crown tour isn't over<n>yet. You'll
have to fend off another<n>fierce opponent in the next
race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Still, I'll be the one who takes the<n>Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The winning concert pulses with<n>incredible energy,
as spectators and<n>Umamusume alike bask in the
excitement until the very last light<n>dims.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's as if they're reluctant to part with<n>the crowning
moment of the Derby<n>dream.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As if they're celebrating the futures<n>of all
Umamusume who have crossed<n>this significant
milestone in their<n>racing careers.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I walk over to Ines Fujin, who sang<n>splendidly as
the lead star of the<n>concert.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Say, Trainer. Do you think I managed<n>to sing well up
to the very end?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I hope I was able to express my<n>gratitude to
everyone for chanting my<n>name the way they did.
choice_data_list: Definitely! It was a great concert!
Definitely! It was a great concert!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to... hear that...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Really... glad...

Ines Fujin collapses onto the cold,<n>hard floor of the
backstage wings.
